# Convert the sex column to a categorical variable
df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] = df['Sex of respondent, 1979'].astype('category')

# Convert the highest grade completed column to a numerical variable
df['Highest grade completed, 1979'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Highest grade completed, 1979'], errors='coerce')

# Perform a t-test to compare the mean highest grade completed between males and females
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

male_grades = df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 1]['Highest grade completed, 1979']
female_grades = df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 2]['Highest grade completed, 1979']

t_stat, p_value = ttest_ind(male_grades, female_grades)
t_stat, p_value

# Check for missing values in the highest grade completed column
missing_values = df['Highest grade completed, 1979'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Missing values in 'Highest grade completed, 1979': {missing_values}")

# Drop rows with missing values in the highest grade completed column
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Highest grade completed, 1979'])

# Perform the t-test on the cleaned data
male_grades_clean = df_clean[df_clean['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 1]['Highest grade completed, 1979']
female_grades_clean = df_clean[df_clean['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 2]['Highest grade completed, 1979']

t_stat_clean, p_value_clean = ttest_ind(male_grades_clean, female_grades_clean)
t_stat_clean, p_value_clean
